title: EnviromentVariable crush when run as Admin
author: yishifengyin

status.label: Covered by merged title-bar startup fix
status.detail: Merged PR 49069 added a non-empty Environment Variables title fallback before the WinUI TitleBar can read an empty native window title during startup.

next_action.label: Post merged-fix status

judgment.rationale: Merged PR 49069 explicitly covers this issue's Environment Variables startup crash. It prevents the elevated resource-title path from leaving the native window title empty before the WinUI TitleBar reads it.
evidence: The issue reports that Environment Variables opens normally without elevation but shows a blank window and crashes within 3-5 seconds when run as administrator.
The issue is labeled Product-Environment Variables and 0.101.
PR 49069 was merged on 2026-07-02 and its summary explicitly says it fixes a class of bugs including this issue.

PR 49069 changed EnvironmentVariablesXAML/MainWindow.xaml.cs so an empty WindowAdminTitle or WindowTitle resource falls back to the non-empty string "Environment Variables" before assigning Window.Title and titleBar.Title.
judgment.recommended_action: Post a merged-fix status pointing reporters to PR 49069; do not create a competing design.

fix_assessment.rationale: Merged PR 49069 implements the concrete fix for the reported elevated startup failure in the affected Environment Variables window.

issue_context.summary: Environment Variables crashes shortly after opening elevated, while the non-elevated window works. The merged title-bar startup fix covers the empty-title path in the affected window.
known_information: The reporter used PowerToys 0.100.0 installed through auto-update.
The failure occurs when Environment Variables is run as administrator; the reporter sees a blank window followed by a crash after 3-5 seconds.
The report includes a PowerToys diagnostic ZIP attachment.
PR 49069 merged on 2026-07-02 and explicitly lists this issue among the title-bar startup faults it addresses.

The merged Environment Variables change obtains WindowAdminTitle for an elevated window, substitutes "Environment Variables" when the resource lookup yields an empty value, then assigns both Window.Title and titleBar.Title.
inferences: The elevated-only symptom is consistent with the WindowAdminTitle resource lookup being the empty-title source, but the original diagnostic archive was not needed to establish that the merged PR covers this issue.
The issue label Status-In progress appears not to have been reconciled after the merged fix.
issue_context.analysis: The report identifies an elevation-specific startup crash, and the merged PR directly documents the matching failure mechanism: WinUI TitleBar can fault during deferred layout if AppWindow.Title is empty. Its Environment Variables change handles both elevated and non-elevated resource lookup results before the title bar reads the title. This is concrete completed coverage, so proposing another implementation would duplicate upstream work.

comment.body: Thanks for the elevation-specific report and diagnostic archive. This crash is covered by merged PR 49069: Environment Variables now falls back to a non-empty window title when the elevated or standard resource title cannot be resolved, before the WinUI TitleBar reads the native title during startup. That prevents the blank-window startup fault described here. The fix was merged on July 2; please use a build that includes it and report back if the elevated launch still crashes.
